lookupHint: Enter a MAC address, or a 24-, 28-, or 36-bit IEEE prefix. Colons, hyphens, dotted and plain formats are supported.
loadError: The registry could not be loaded. Try again.
noResultsHint: Try a different prefix, organization name, or registry.
emptyLookupHint: Enter an address above, or try an example to see its registered organization and block.
invalidAddress: Enter a complete MAC address or a valid 24-, 28-, or 36-bit prefix.
noAssignmentHint: This address does not match an allocation in this IEEE snapshot.
sourceHint: Lookup runs in your browser using a bundled IEEE snapshot.

typeHints.universal: The registered organization identifies the address allocation, which may differ from the device brand.
typeHints.local: This address is locally administered and may be randomized. Its prefix cannot reliably identify a device vendor.
typeHints.multicast: This is a group address. A vendor cannot be inferred from an IEEE unicast allocation.
typeHints.broadcast: This address sends to every device on the local network; it has no individual vendor.
typeHints.zero: The all-zero address is an unspecified address; it does not identify a device vendor.
typeHints.prefix: A prefix identifies a registered block. Longer allocations take priority when looking up a full MAC address.

cidHint: CID identifies an organization for local addressing. It is not a globally unique MAC address allocation.
registrySizes: MA-L: /24 · MA-M: /28 · MA-S and IAB: /36 · CID: company identifier
lookupAboutBody: A MAC address has 48 bits. The IEEE assigns organizations prefixes of 24, 28, or 36 bits. This tool matches the longest registered prefix and shows the allocation owner, address range, and registry. Locally administered and group addresses are identified separately.
blocksAboutBody: Browse all five public IEEE registries. Search a prefix, organization, or registered address, then open a block to see its range and capacity. MA-L allocates 16,777,216 addresses, MA-M allocates 1,048,576, and MA-S or IAB allocates 4,096. CID is a company identifier for local addressing.
vendorsAboutBody: Search organization names and their registered postal addresses, then select an organization to see all its assignments. Names and addresses come from the IEEE listing and are shown as registered. An allocation owner is not necessarily the brand of a device, and these addresses do not locate the device.
